Blades 0.47 includes FFmpeg 2.8.22 and ported Simple360Player H264 filters.
The combined executable is distributed under GNU GPL version 3; see LICENSE
and SIMPLE360PLAYER-GPL-3.0.txt. Original Blades files remain available under
their MIT notices (BLADES-MIT.txt). FFmpeg's original LGPL2.1+ source notices
are preserved; this build enables GPL and version3 and disables nonfree code.
Fonts, artwork and the SDK retain their separate attribution and licences.

Simple360Player upstream: https://github.com/HG-ERIK/simple360player
Pinned commit: 5d235c1fd24c098ccc1b2463c1b4265bf2e7844c.
Ported h264_chroma_xb.c/h264_qpel_xb.c: GCC intrinsics and FFmpeg context/stride
API adaptations; synchronized runtime self-tests. No XDK binary is linked.
Complete corresponding source, all local modifications, build scripts and a
pinned open-source SDK are supplied alongside the executable in:
https://github.com/sbayfield09/Blades/raw/refs/heads/main/dist/Blades-v0.47-source.zip
The immutable matching download is also in the release instructions.
See BUILDING.txt within it to modify, rebuild or relink using free xsdk/GCC.
There is no warranty. Playback does not use a proprietary player or firmware.

Blades0.47 also adapts native HTTP/JSON/auth/browser code from XenonFin,
https://github.com/sbayfield09/XenonFin at commit
554adb8d79a251e4b502ac4a87a328cbe5055b09. XenonFin's original source is
GPL-2.0-or-later; the combined executable remains GPLv3. See
XENONFIN-GPL-2.0.txt and the original/ported sources, hashes and notices in
the matching complete source bundle. The private login/session file is not
included. No Microsoft firmware or proprietary SDK is distributed.
